name: Biosystems and Agricultural Engineering PhD
detailsNote: Available official requirements; older handbook conditions and undated dates qualified. Admission model omitted if not established.

english.toefl: 94 legacy iBT; new-scale programme threshold unconfirmed
english.note: Central minimum. US accredited degree or official transcript/direct registrar attestation confirming sole English instruction can satisfy proficiency. DET may be evaluated by ESL professional. Program may set higher standard. BAE requires 94/IELTS 7/DET 115,≤2 years.

applicationFee.note: Domestic fee 65. Conditional waiver for US military veterans or spouses/dependents with qualifying benefits documentation. No explicit citizenship rule stated; international applicants must confirm qualification. No general hardship waiver established.

requirements.note: Undergraduate GPA 2.8/graduate 3.0. Prior faculty adviser agreement required. CV, personal statement, all transcripts. GRE/GMAT may be required, no minimum set; confirm requirement, no waiver inferred.

funding.note: Assistantships depend on funding/course of study. RA stipend, tuition and health insurance possible; no universal guarantee or current amount retained.
